label: RRFS v1 (NOAA Rapid Refresh Forecast System, FV3 limited area, operational from 2026-11-03 12 UTC)
match_level_meaning: Same scheme families as WOOF ports of WRF releases, same grid spacing, levels, cadence and inputs where public; the dycore, the step and the physics coupling never match and are declared below. Not 'RRFS on GPUs' and not 'matches RRFS'.

declared_differences.source: FV3 limited area, D-grid, Lagrangian vertical with remapping (det/input.nml:97-108, :130)
declared_differences.here: ARW, C-grid, Eulerian vertical, Runge-Kutta with acoustic substeps

declared_differences.source: 36 s physics and model step (exrrfs_forecast.sh:722; set_rrfs_config_general.sh:418)
declared_differences.here: 15 s start under the adaptive clock on the CONUS grid

declared_differences.source: one physics call per step, schemes applied in sequence with the state updated between them, a two-pass surface loop (suite_RRFS_sas.xml lines 41, 60)
declared_differences.here: ARW tendencies carried through the Runge-Kutta stages, microphysics as an end-of-step adjustment, one surface pass

declared_differences.source: Extended Schmidt Gnomonic, one regional tile (set_predef_grid_params.sh:854-864)
declared_differences.here: Lambert (CONUS) or polar stereographic (North America) on the projection plane

declared_differences.source: about 2.1 hPa, 65 layers (VCOORD_FILE global_hyblev_fcst_rrfsL65.txt, config_defaults.sh:1754; that file is not in NOAA's public fix bucket, so the exact top is not checked)
declared_differences.here: 15 hPa until package B1 (stratospheric base state) lands

declared_differences.source: GFS native-level netCDF hourly to f102
declared_differences.here: GFS 0.25 degree pressure-level GRIB2 hourly (public native files stop at f012)

declared_differences.source: the CONUS region is the interior of the North American run
declared_differences.here: the CONUS tier has its own lateral boundary at the CONUS edge (arm R narrows this by taking RRFS's own forecast as boundaries)

declared_differences.source: RRFS's CONUS forecast starts from its own cycled analysis
declared_differences.here: the arm GS profile starts from a GFS 6 h forecast (f006 of the 6 h older cycle); arms G and R start from RRFS's posted analysis

declared_differences.source: CCPP GSL drag suite at ccpp-physics edd85a55 (physics/GWD/drag_suite.F90): turbulent form drag coefficient 0.2214 (:1367), no small-scale taper (ss_taper = 1, :626-627), varmax_fd 500 (:438), e-folding height fixed at 1500 m (:1362), semi-implicit in the 36 s step (:1371-1372)
declared_differences.here: WRF v4.7.1 module_bl_gwdo_gsl as ported, held to WRF at 0 ULP: coefficient 0.0759 (TOFD_coeff), small-scale taper from 0 at 1 km to 1 at 12 km, varmax_fd 160, e-folding height min(max(2 varss, PBL height), 1500 m), explicit in the step. On the 64 oracle columns at 3 km and 36 s the largest form-drag tendency is 6.4 times WOOF's and the column form stress 3.7 to 10.4 times, median 4.2; coefficient and taper alone give 4.0 (tools/ccpp_column_oracle/receipts). Not a port defect: a later generation of the scheme

rrfs-sas-enkf-members.notes: The EnKF member forecasts run the deterministic suite file with smoke off (rrfs_sd false, enkf/input.nml:272); every other physics setting equals det/input.nml.

rrfs-sas-nogwd-fire-weather.notes: The deterministic suite without drag_suite (gwd_opt 0), with no lake model (lkm default 0), smoke off (rrfs_sd false, firewx/input.nml:244) and no HAILCAST (do_hailcast unset, default false); mix_chem is unset (default false). The engine already refuses terrain drag on a child nest, which is this suite's own setting. The nest itself waits on package F1 and the reproduced gpuwm check defect on nested trees.

source_rules.meaning: Every source setting or scheme of the imitated system that the engine cannot honour, and the declared row it obliges. A suite's source_settings record what its own namelist sets, with line numbers; an unset key takes the default below. A rule holds for a suite when the suite's own suite file runs the named scheme, or when its effective value of the named setting is not one the engine honours. A holding rule needs its declared row, and every declared row needs a holding rule.

nssl_alphah.ref: set only by the NSSL members; it stands for the five per-member NSSL constants (nssl_alphah, nssl_alphar, nssl_cccn, nssl_ehw0, nssl_ehlw0)

conus-product-grid-65.describes: RRFS's CONUS product grid (Lambert 1799 x 1059 at 3 km, 38.5 N, 97.5 W; exrrfs_prdgen.sh:429), which is the HRRR CONUS grid octet for octet
conus-product-grid-65.target_waits_on: the exact-grid identity ingest route (freeze lane 01); today one row is trimmed on every side, same centre
conus-product-grid-65.p_top_target_waits_on: package B1 (stratospheric base state and the 65-level ladder from the public regression table)
conus-product-grid-65.p_top_target_status: ESTIMATE: RRFS names VCOORD_FILE global_hyblev_fcst_rrfsL65.txt (config_defaults.sh:1754), which is not in NOAA's public fix bucket; the value is unchecked against that file

north-america-grid-k-65.describes: a polar stereographic 3 km grid true at 45 N, standard longitude 120 W, that covers all four RRFS regional product grids and stops 4.5 rows short of the pole
north-america-grid-k-65.runs_waits_on: cross-host exchange (freeze lane 13): nothing North American fits one 8-card host; preparation needs about 0.5 TB of host RAM

cycles.public_start_hours_note: MEASURED 2026-10-03 on noaa-rrfs-ops-pds and NOMADS rrfs/v1.0: the hourly prslev and 2dfld CONUS pair (85 files each, f000 to f084) is posted only for the 00/06/12/18 UTC cycles; the other cycles post only the sub-hourly 2dfld set (18 files). So a CONUS run started from RRFS's posted analysis can start only at those four hours.

G.meaning: GFS hourly boundaries, as RRFS's own North American run takes them, applied at the CONUS edge
G.initial_from: RRFS's posted f000 analysis pair (prslev + 2dfld) through prep --initial-inputs
G.prepared_route: mapped hourly GFS pressure-level forcing with a separately declared RRFS analysis through prep --initial-inputs; configs/rrfs_v1_like/SCORING.md states the complete paired analysis inventory and commands
G.measured_cut: 128 x 96 x 65, one forecast hour from the 2026-10-03 12 UTC analysis, GFS 06 UTC f006/f007 boundaries, preparation on CPU and forecast through the prepared go door
G.profile_waits_on: [fetch] names one source, so a bare GS profile remains a GFS start. Arm G uses the explicitly bound prepared route, not a relabelled bare GS profile.

GS.meaning: GFS start and GFS hourly boundaries at the CONUS edge: the start is the 6 h forecast of the 6 h older GFS cycle, the cycle RRFS's own boundaries come from. The start is a declared difference from arm G, which starts from RRFS's analysis.
GS.initial_from: the forcing source's f006 (forecast_start_hour 6), not an analysis

R.meaning: RRFS's own posted forecast as the boundaries (and the start)

GC.meaning: GFS cold start and GFS hourly boundaries, the only public road for a North American start (no public 3 km North American RRFS state exists)
GC.initial_from: GFS analysis or the 3 h forecast, as RRFS cold-starts its spin-up
